cases.name: Kelsey Abigail Williams
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Kelsey was born and raised in Calhoun County and attended Saks High School. She was a bright and vibrant girl with a loving heart who cared for everyone. She lived her life to the fullest enjoying simple pleasures - spending time with her family, friends, nieces and nephews and her dog, Bella. She touched the lives of many people and was a loving daughter, sister, and friend to many. She will be greatly missed."
